basis: Rounded national-average retail prices recalled from well-known public sources (BLS CPI average prices, USDA, EIA, AAA, STR, DOT, FDA/KFF) and published list prices; not queried live. Apply regions.cost_of_living_multiplier to scale for local conditions (it moves most goods less than rent). Sales tax is not included.

fields.categories[].basis: Short note on where the category figures come from.
fields.items[].name: Item description.
fields.items[].unit: Quantity the price applies to (per gallon, per night, per month, per person, and so on).
fields.items[].price_cents.min: Integer cents; low end (store brand, discount, budget tier or low-cost region).
fields.items[].price_cents.max: Integer cents; ordinary high end (premium mainstream, not luxury or surge extremes).

conventions.ordering: min <= typical <= max for every item (validated).
conventions.tax_and_tip: Prices exclude sales tax and tip unless the item name says otherwise.
conventions.fuel_and_charging: Fuel is cents per gallon; EV charging rows are cents per kWh.
